timecoded_text_to_speech.text: An article published by Time.com asserts that the world is becoming more complex and changes
accelerating exponentially.
Without a doubt, machine learning and artificial intelligence are the two advanced technologies
ruling the current marketplace.
These branches of technology have the power to transform the way businesses operate and
how humans interact to perform complex tasks, however, being an expert in the field of AI
requires specific skills.
In this video, I will share with you nine skills that will be the most lucrative as
artificial intelligence advances.
Analytical Skills Analytical skills are essential because it allows you to evaluate
problems both simple and complex, find solutions to the issues and make decisions about what
actions to take next.
This skill incorporates many skills like attention to detail, critical thinking ability, decision-making,
and research and skills to analyze a question or problem and reach a solution.
Analytical skills are required for a lot of AI jobs from real estate agent to data scientist.
The ultimate goal of most AI innovation is to create technology that solves our human
problems for us.
The best artificial intelligence will not just follow a set of predetermined rules, but
rather it will learn how to solve problems creatively.
Understanding problems and analyzing the situation for viable solutions is a critical
skill in every position at every level of the transition to AI.
Creative problem solving is the next major step for AI, and that's why the analytical
skill is in such high demand.
Mathematical Skills
Data scientist and AI instructor Abhishek Parrakha once wrote, a person working in the
field of AI who doesn't know math is like a politician who doesn't know how to persuade.
Both have an inescapable area to work upon.
An ideal candidate for the AI domain must be an expert in a broad set of algorithms and
applied math.
Such candidates should be well versed with superb problem solving and analytical skills,
which could help them perform the given tasks efficiently.
Fred Saragyani, the CTO of a leading digital trust provider, SIPT science once remarked,
we're looking primarily for people who have a principled understanding of the statistics,
probabilities and math necessary to grasp the problem.
That's the foundation of all this.

algorithm best addresses a problem and the way to optimize the outcomes.
Lateral Thinking
Lateral thinking is also referred to as creativity.
According to the Maltese Physician, author, inventor and consultant in originator of the
term Lateral thinking, Edward De Bono, there is no doubt that creativity is the most important
human resource of all.
Without creativity, there would be no progress, and we will be forever repeating the same
patterns.
To excel in the AI domain, programmers need to have a curious and creative mind.
This curiosity and creativity helps them discover novel ways to approach specific problems
and come up with innovative solutions for cracking them.
Besides, Lateral thinking allows them to grab abstract information efficiently and be
clear with the possibilities to process it well.
Furthermore, leaders of the future need to be able to connect dots that haven't been
connected before.
To create new ideas, through fresh thinking and innovation.
Problem Solving
According to computer science, problem solving is a part of artificial intelligence that
encompasses several techniques such as algorithms and heuristics to solve a problem.
There are two different types of action takers, the reflex based and the goal based.

Problem solving is a goal based action taken process.
